description: Fuel needed and cost of a trip from distance (km or miles, optionally round trip), fuel price (per litre, US gallon or UK gallon) and consumption in L/100 km, km/L, mpg (US) or mpg (UK); split between people; cost per km/mile and per 100. Optionally compare a second car (its own consumption and, if different, fuel price). Also converts the consumption to the other units. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/fuel-cost/

consumptionUnit.description: Its consumption unit (l100, kml, mpgus, mpguk).

price.description: Its fuel price if different (same priceUnit).

consumption.description: Car consumption / economy, e.g. 7.5 (L/100 km) or 35 (mpg).

consumptionUnit.description: l100 = L/100 km, kml = km/L, mpgus, mpguk.

currency.description: Currency label for the text, e.g. "JD" or "$".

people.description: Split the cost between this many people.

priceUnit.description: The price is per litre, US gallon or UK gallon.

name: calc_fuel_cost
title: Fuel cost of a trip
